name_vi: Giỏ giữ bánh dẹt có nắp
description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A low round basket has a lift-off woven lid and a blank washable fabric liner. Side: Its squat cylinder shows a continuous broad bound rim. Rear: The back has no handle or hinge and repeats the closed woven wall. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A low round basket has a lift-off woven lid and a blank washable fabric liner. Side: Its squat cylinder shows a continuous broad bound rim. Rear: The back has no handle or hinge and repeats the closed woven wall. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.. Style Rustic: sturdy handmade character and visible bindings. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, wood/bamboo support only where described, and only specified plain secondary materials. Do not add rigid frames or legs to flexible mats or other products that do not specify them. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, at the same sensible elevation as the canonical front, keeping the product in its natural resting orientation. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions. PRIORITY VIEW CHECK: The requested visible surface is the side, specifically: Its squat cylinder shows a continuous broad bound rim.. For a narrow side/end profile, the original broad front face must be edge-on and strongly foreshortened. For the rear, front-only pockets, latch faces and low front panels must be on the far side; any taller rear panel must be closest to camera. Do not repeat the original broad front composition unless the product is structurally rotationally symmetric. Keep the natural resting pose from the front reference. Do not flip, tip or stand the product upright merely to show underside reinforcement; that reinforcement may remain partly occluded.
